Players Committee card image of [[Leia's Resistance Transport]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “May add 2 pilots and 5 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Deploys and moves like a starfighter. When deployed, may ▼ a female Resistance character aboard for free.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/Leia%27s%20Resistance%20Transport.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/Leia's Resistance Transport.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
